high.caveat: E17_PREREG.md §4.1: the high-noise expert only runs above sigma 0.875; at t=600 (sigma 0.600) it is OUT OF RANGE, so its AUC describes 'a 14B denoiser trained on another noise band', not this expert's competence in its own regime

q1.note: both experts are trained 14B denoisers on the same data; a split verdict would mean the D1 call depends on which noise band the expert specialises in

q2.threshold_source: E16 probe-partition sd, median over IntPhys2 cells
q2.note: |delta| < threshold => the expert-to-expert difference is inside the noise this probe already has; the model cannot be used to argue that noise-band specialisation changes D1

note: Q2's delta mixes two things that this design cannot separate: how much each expert specialises in its noise band, and how well either generalises to a band it did not train on (E17_PREREG.md §4.2). Reported as a bound, not as an attribution.
